alt: Instagram's 2026 redesigned wordmark displayed in black on a light background, showing the distinctive new lowercase 'r' letterform that closely resembles a 'z'
story: Instagram unveiled its first wordmark redesign in a decade on August 13, 2026, but the stylised lowercase 'r' sits so close to the 'g' that the internet immediately renamed the platform 'Instagzam' — a typography design flaw baked into a global brand refresh used by two billion people.
why_funny: A trillion-dollar company hired designers to update four letters and shipped a logo that mispells the product name at first glance.
